title: Lonna C NDE 3199
content: I quit breathing and my heart stopped, my mom and dad called the doctor because they were scared. By the time he got there, I was setting up in the corner of my bedroom seeing all that was going on. Behind me was a dark tunnel with a light at the end. I was so engrossed in what was going on in the room that I ignored the light and all. As the doctor let my folks know that I was gone, they started to cry. It was very hard to see for me at the time, so I prayed to go to them so they would stop crying. All of a sudden, there I was on the bed looking up at them. It was so strange that I didn't tell anyone for a long time. Even when I did, no one had ever heard of this before. Years later I started to hear about NDEs.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Illness Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) . I had an asthma attack stopped breathing and then my heart stopped.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | Strong emotional tone
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I was a kid and had no idea if it was good or bad.
